text: Do good to those who deserve it, and they will thank you.
Be kind to the godly, and they—or God Most High— will reward you.
But you will have no success if you keep doing evil and refuse to give to the poor. *
Help those who are humble and faithful to God,
but don't help the ungodly. If you give food to sinners, they will become strong and overpower you. Do a good deed for them, and they will reward you by wronging you twice.
But God Most High hates ungodly sinners and will punish them.
Yes, give to good people, not to sinners.
In hard times you will discover your true friends and your real enemies.
Even your enemies act friendly when you are well off, but only true friends stay when trouble strikes.
Never trust your enemies— their evil will attack you like rust
eating away at an unpolished mirror.[26] So be on guard against them, even if they bow down and act humble.
Don't make them your partners, or they will push you aside and take over. Then you will know I was right, and you will feel the sting of my words.
If you try to charm snakes or to tame wild animals, who will take pity when you get bitten?
In the same way, no one will take pity if you are friendly with sinners and start sinning yourself.
Enemies act loyal for a while, but they won't stand by you when you need help.
They tell you how much they want to be your friends, all the while plotting to put you in your grave. They weep when you are sad, but they will try to kill you the first chance they get.
If you are struck by disaster, they pretend to help but pull you down instead.
Then they laugh and sneer, making vulgar hand signs, showing what kind of friends they really are.
